integrity: The original binomial multiplication table is credited to Adashev--Omirov--Khudoyberdiyev (2007), and the new claim is limited to joint modular Jordan/rank distributions and boundary geometry. Tests are finite and not treated as infinite proof. A previously published three-dimensional characteristic-two handed-annihilator example is also credited and excluded from novelty.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the explicit truncated one-generator Zinbiel algebra with \(2\le n\le p+1\) in characteristic \(p\); no complete classification of all modular Zinbiel algebras, larger dimensions, or nonreduced rank schemes. Historical publication priority and independent mathematical audit unresolved.
title: The first modular rank gap in one-generated Zinbiel algebras
